Name: Maru Dutch-Xhosa Wedding Dress
Author: Elaho
TagLine:
Changes Maru's wedding sprite to incorporate both Dutch and Xhosa wedding traditions.
Now with seasonal variations!
Description:
**UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod.**

This mod changes Maru's wedding sprite to incorporate both Dutch and Xhosa wedding traditions:

_Xhosa wedding traditions (with a modern twist):_
- Black __isicholo__ (head dress), adorned with white beads
- Black and white __umbaco__ (long skirt), beautifully embroidered with beadwork
- Black shawl, representing nurturing and protection
- Black and white marriage bib and beaded belt
- Other black beaded jewellery, such as bracelets and earrings

_Dutch wedding traditions:_
- Dutch wedding clogs (with intricate details carved into the wood)
- Evergreen branches for eternal love
- Lily of the Valley for long-lasting love and happiness
- Orange accents, including beaded necklaces and trim (orange is the national colour of the Netherlands)

In this mod, I've decided to give Robin a Dutch ancestry and Demetrius a Xhosa/Tswana ancestry- making Maru a combination of both.
Perhaps the most 'controversial' of the pairings so far (given the history between the Dutch and Xhosa/Tswana people of South Africa); but, in all reality, the only thing that keeps people apart is geography - not politics, history, or race.

I wanted Maru to embody the best of both her parents and ancestors, by giving her a fusion of both Dutch and Xhosa wedding traditions. And I think she would want to embody all that she is on her big day and new journey with your farmer.
(**_Fun fact:_** Maru means "clouds" in Tswana, and I thought that was a perfect fit for part of her heritage- Maru is always thinking and inventing new things, with her 'head in the clouds,' gazing at the stars above.)

__Ndiyakuvuyela ukutshata!__
__Gefeliciteerd met je trouwdag!__
------------------------------------
*PLEASE NOTE:

**UPDATE: V.1.1.3 [or higher] is now compatible with Poltergeister's Slightly Cuter Aesthetic mod. No action needed**.

This mod will NOT work with other wedding outfit mods that include Maru. If you want this mod to be compatible with other sprite editing mods, you'll need to either delete Maru's wedding version in those mods or only have this one installed. Having two different mods that change Maru's wedding appearance will not work together and may cause the game to crash.*
